BackstoryDef.title: firstborn night predator
BackstoryDef.description: Shaped in the primordial darkness at the dawn of humanity, [PAWN_nameDef] was the very first of [PAWN_possessive] bloodline to walk the night. [PAWN_pronoun] learned early to stalk mortal tribes with regal patience and terrifying speed.

BackstoryDef.title: ancient sire of vampires
BackstoryDef.description: Patriarch of every vampire nest across the world, [PAWN_nameDef] carries himself with aristocratic poise and ancient, predatory authority. Calmer and far wiser than [PAWN_possessive] feral descendants, [PAWN_pronoun] seeks to preserve [PAWN_possessive] kind from both hunters and apocalyptic tyrants.

BackstoryDef.title: primordial abyssal beast
BackstoryDef.description: Spawned in the darkest depths before angels or humans ever existed, [PAWN_nameDef] possessed an insatiable hunger and a mind built for domination. Sealed away for eons because [PAWN_possessive] kind threatened to devour all creation, [PAWN_pronoun] waited patiently for release.

BackstoryDef.title: invulnerable corporate apex
BackstoryDef.description: Wearing the polished smile of a billionaire CEO, [PAWN_nameDef] leads the Leviathans in turning humanity into compliant, fattened livestock. Practically invulnerable to conventional weapons, [PAWN_pronoun] combines ruthless corporate strategy with monstrous physical supremacy.

BackstoryDef.title: ancient purgatory broodmother
BackstoryDef.description: Older than angels and born from the same primordial stock as the Leviathans, [PAWN_nameDef] lingered in the shadowy wilds of Purgatory for millennia. From that dark realm, [PAWN_pronoun] shaped the first bloodlines of every monster clan.

BackstoryDef.title: mother of all monsters
BackstoryDef.description: Fiercely protective of the monstrous children [PAWN_pronoun] spawned, [PAWN_nameDef] emerged into the mortal realm to avenge the slaughter of [PAWN_possessive] Alphas. Cold, maternal, and terrifyingly creative, [PAWN_pronoun] breeds twisted new predators to overwhelm [PAWN_possessive] enemies.

BackstoryDef.title: bayou dockhand
BackstoryDef.description: Raised along the humid bayous and ports of Louisiana, [PAWN_nameDef] grew up working fishing boats and learning Cajun cooking before a night raid claimed [PAWN_possessive] mortal life. Even after being turned, [PAWN_pronoun] clung to a quiet sense of honor.

BackstoryDef.title: reformed vampire bruiser
BackstoryDef.description: Having fought for survival through the brutal wilds of Purgatory alongside a mortal hunter, [PAWN_nameDef] renounced preying on innocent humans. Soft-spoken, loyal, and deadly in close quarters, [PAWN_pronoun] stands as a rare ally caught between hunters and monsters.

BackstoryDef.title: ravenous abyssal hound
BackstoryDef.description: Born among the ferocious Leviathan pack in the primordial dark, [PAWN_nameDef] excelled at tracking prey and tearing rival beasts limb from limb. [PAWN_pronoun] respected only apex strength and absolute hierarchy.

BackstoryDef.title: leviathan chief enforcer
BackstoryDef.description: Right-hand muscle and chief field cleaner for Dick Roman, [PAWN_nameDef] wears a sharp suit over a terrifying, razor-mawed predator form. Brutal, relentless, and nearly impossible to put down, [PAWN_pronoun] hunts down rogue monsters and meddling hunters alike.
